answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 949 Country: India Title: Why is music prohibited in Islam? Question: Why is music prohibited in Islam? Answer ID: 949 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 686=703/J) Music is prohibited in Islam; since Allah Almighty and His messenger (peace be upon him) have disallowed it. For a Muslim, this is the major reason. There is no other reason greater than this one. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
